Key “Day Of” Responsibilities of the SME Facilitator: - Instruct teams to appoint a spokesperson to report at the end of the workshop. - Encourage good time management for the group. Keep the team on track for the completion of this activity within the 1-hour time frame. - Be prepared to explain the activity and goals of this workshop. - Give insight and provide technical expertise and insight about different options and their impacts relevant to this activity - Subject matter experts and activity support staff will be available to answer questions about the technologies on the cards. Key Steps for the Team Please note that key roles and responsibilities for the SME facilitator are bolded. However, all of the information included can be helpful and important for the SME and their team to consider. Goal Setting Teams should relate their goals to their own organizational goals and/or the Better Buildings goals they have set. Additionally, the goals should be clear and measurable. For example: - Achieve a 20% energy reduction - Achieve a 20% energy reduction with a payback of less than X years - Create a building that has reduced consumption to the point that on-site renewables can balance the load In this case, these can all be translated to energy (EUI) targets, if the group desires o (i.e., retrofit the building to use less than 30 kBtu/ft2) They may also want to set some other goals that are a bit softer—but these should be in addition to some energy/environmental goals (e.g., execute the renovation without displacing staff). These goals are hard to quantify but might help the team prioritize their card selections. Card Selection Setting clear goals provides a framework for deciding which cards to select. Tables should look at the cards by color family and discuss which card to select. As cards are selected, someone can start to fill in the worksheet. Please feel free to add some color to the discussion about this being the result of an energy audit of the building and that owners should have an expectation that audits will provide ideas that include energy savings and up-front costs.
